name: Minimum Teaching Size
definition: For a nonempty binary class $C\subseteq\{0,1\}^X$, minimize $|S|$ over a concept $c\in C$ and a coordinate set $S\subseteq X$ such that $c$ is the only member of $C$ with restriction $c|_S$.
parameters: A finite nonempty binary class on a displayed coordinate set.
normalization: A singleton has value zero; the full $n$-cube has value $n$. The minimum is over concepts as well as their teaching sets.
